The '''Trostlos Waste''' was a region on [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]]. The [[Ven Karya Spaceport]] was located at the edge of the Trostlos Waste.

==Behind the scenes==
"Trostlos" is the [[Wikipedia:German language|German]] word for "desolate".
